title: Well and Portrait
author: C. M. Nystrom
blurb: Elodie Quintana, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
